environment.description: Defines top level environment (key, value) support

schedule.description: Run this deployment as scheduled job.

min-nodes.description: Minimum number of nodes for deployment. (Used for deployment check)

port.description: Application internal Port to be used for discover check (Value of 0 disable discover check)

path.description: Optional path to be used for performing deployment check. If null, empty or un-specified, only discover check is performed.

timeout.description: Deployment check timeout represented in terms of seconds or minutes. e.g: 20s for timeout of 20 seconds

attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts for deployment check before marking deployment as failed.

timeout.description: Deployment stop timeout represented in terms of seconds or minutes. e.g: 30s for timeout of 30 seconds. The application will be sent SIGTERM signal and will have this time for its cleanup.

check-retries.description: Maximum no. of retries to be attempted to check if deployment is stopped.

listeners.description: TCP Listeners associated with proxy (for tcp based proxy)

hostname.description: Hostname(s) to be registered with proxy. If multiple hosts need to be specified, separate them using comma or space

location.description: Proxy location definition for a given proxy path

path.description: Path to be used for proxy

force-ssl.description: If SSL needs to be forced at the given path

health.description: Health check definition for proxy upstream

timeout.description: Health check timeout represented in terms of seconds or minutes. e.g: 20s for timeout of 20 seconds

uri.description: Path to be used for health check. If empty or not specified, tcp based check is used.

interval.description: Interval to be used for health check. e.g.: 30s to run health check every 30 seconds.

level.description: Min level for the message to activate this notifier

room.description: Room to be used for notification

token.description: Hipchat API v2 token (personal/ room) for notification
